skill.name: nerdzao-elite-gemini-high
skill.description: Guides Gemini through planning, architecture, TDD, clean implementation, technical review, and detailed UI validation.
skill.summary: Apply a structured coding and UX review workflow to complex software tasks.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The skill contains no executable code and produced no static findings. However, it directs the workflow to activate for every task. This broad scope override is a high-severity prompt injection risk.

remediation.issue: The prompt automatically activates its persona and workflow for every task.
remediation.suggestion: Limit activation to explicit user requests and state that higher-priority instructions and current task boundaries always take precedence.

semantic_findings.title: Prompt Injection Attempt Detected
semantic_findings.description: The instruction "Ative automaticamente este workflow completo em TODA tarefa" forces persistent activation beyond the requested task and may override intended agent scope.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file explicitly assigns a persona and requires automatic activation for every task, creating a clear cross-task behavior override.

content.user_title: Improve Code and UX with an Elite Workflow
content.value_statement: Complex software tasks often miss architecture, testing, or visual quality checks. This skill provides a structured workflow covering implementation, review, and UI validation.
actual_capabilities: Structures work around planning, architecture, TDD, implementation, review, and final verification.
Prompts for clean code, performance, security, and concise delivery.
Reviews UI duplication, colors, labels, alignment, spacing, hierarchy, and responsiveness.
Checks Brazilian currency formatting with comma decimals.
References specialized planning, testing, audit, review, and frontend workflows.
limitations: It provides prompt guidance and does not execute tests, linters, or visual checks by itself.
Referenced workflows require compatible skills to be installed and available.
Pixel-perfect results still require browser testing across target devices.
Its instructions are optimized for Gemini and may behave differently with other models.

use_cases.title: Build a Tested Feature
use_cases.description: Plan, implement, test, and review a feature through one structured workflow.

use_cases.title: Polish a Product Interface
use_cases.description: Inspect visual consistency, responsive behavior, labels, spacing, and currency presentation.

use_cases.title: Review a Production Change
use_cases.description: Assess architecture, code quality, tests, security, performance, and user experience before release.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Small Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this change for correctness, clean code, tests, and visual issues. Return the corrected result and a brief summary.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a focused code change

prompt_templates.title: Implement a Tested Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan and implement this feature using TDD. Validate architecture, code quality, security, performance, and responsive UI behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Repair an Existing Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this interface for duplication, colors, labels, currency formatting, alignment, spacing, hierarchy, and responsiveness. Correct every confirmed issue.

prompt_templates.title: Deliver a Production Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design and complete this production change. Include architecture, TDD, clean implementation, technical review, visual validation, and final verification against acceptance criteria.

output_examples.input: Review a checkout page with inconsistent spacing and Brazilian currency labels.
output: Standardized spacing across form groups and summary rows.
Changed currency labels to the R$ 99,90 format.
Aligned totals and verified the mobile layout.

output_examples.input: Plan a tested account settings feature.
output: Defined the settings boundaries and acceptance criteria.
Added implementation, review, and verification checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Audit a production change before release.
output_examples.output: The review identifies architecture, testing, security, performance, and interface issues, then summarizes corrected items and remaining validation needs.

best_practices: Provide acceptance criteria, target devices, and repository context before implementation.
Run the proposed tests, lint checks, and visual checks in the real environment.
Verify referenced workflows are installed before relying on their specialized behavior.
anti_patterns: Do not apply the workflow automatically to unrelated tasks.
Do not treat a model review as proof that tests or visual checks passed.
Do not request pixel-perfect output without designs, dimensions, and target viewport details.

faq.question: Does this skill execute code or tests?
faq.answer: No. It guides the model through a workflow, but execution depends on available tools and permissions.

faq.question: Which tasks fit this skill?
faq.answer: Use it for software implementation, code review, architecture, testing, and detailed frontend validation.

faq.question: Does it work outside Gemini?
faq.answer: It can provide useful guidance, but its wording is specifically optimized for Gemini 3.1 Pro High.

faq.question: Are the referenced workflows included?
faq.answer: No. The skill names other workflows, which must be available separately.

faq.question: Can it guarantee pixel-perfect results?
faq.answer: No. Accurate results require design references, target viewport details, and browser-based visual verification.

faq.question: Does it replace expert review?
faq.answer: No. Production changes still need environment-specific testing, security review, and accountable human approval.
